messages:
jess_oncall: Pager triggered — org=SignalCrest, sudden rate spike on inference requests, quota rejections visible. 5xx% up ~2.8x in last 3m. tagging SRE.
sergio_sre: I see increased queue latency on the vcpu-proxy and a lot of throttled token errors from the RL layer. Are customers seeing user-facing failures or just slower responses?
maya_support: Support tickets from SignalCrest reporting 'model unavailable' errors and increased latency in prod. Customer is on dedicated tier but using burst capacity.
jess_oncall: Impact: SignalCrest has ~4% of our overall QPS but spike pattern is very bursty — causing contention on batching and hitting per-org rate checks. Need quick mitigation to avoid cascading backoffs.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: #INC-2026-17498222 - SignalCrest surge gating. Priority: P1. Paging oncall. Link: https://incidents.redwood/17498222
eli_runtime: Quick check: there are a lot of long-running streaming sessions — KV cache growth looks fine but kernel queue depth is saturated on two pods. Might be a misbehaving client sending many parallel short prompts.
ops_ryan: Recommend temporary per-org rate cap reduction + enable soft-queueing. We can also disable non-essential model variants for that org. Which is fastest?
jess_oncall: Fastest is a per-org emergency rate cap change. Can we push a hotpatch to reduce max concurrent requests for SignalCrest to 60% of normal, then monitor.
sergio_sre: I'll run the safety command. Applying now.
sergio_sre: ```
# emergency RL adjustment
POST /admin/orgs/signalcrest/rate_override HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json

{"override_pct":"60","reason":"surge-gate: emergency mitigation","expires_in":"30m","actor":"sergio_sre"}
```
sergio_sre: Applied override. New effective qps limit should propagate in ~10s. Rolling through proxies now.
maya_support: Customer is asking for ETA. I told them we're applying protections and will follow up.
jess_oncall: Monitoring dashboards — 5xx down from 3.2% -> 0.8% over last 2m. Latency tails improving. Good signal.
eli_runtime: Also disabled experimental low-cost variant for SignalCrest (model: small-mmap-v2) to reduce load on shared kernels. That freed a few pods.
ops_ryan: Noted. We'll keep override at 60% for 30m, then re-evaluate. If traffic still spikey, escalate to 40% or request customer-side throttling.
sergio_sre: Doced the change in the incident page and pushed an audit event. Command used: `/rl override --org=signalcrest --pct=60 --ttl=30m --reason="surge-gate emergency"`
jess_oncall: Handoff to sergio for next 30m watch. I'm tagging followup items for postmortem: root cause (client burst pattern), better automatic burst isolation, and customer playbook.
maya_support: I'll schedule a customer sync with SignalCrest for post-incident notes and ask them to add a 10qps client-side cap while we analyze.
ops_ryan: If anyone needs to extend the override reply here with approval from eng-lead. Otherwise I'll start scaling down emergency measures at +30m. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: state=mitigated, lead=sergio_sre, severity=P1, actions=[rate_override_60pct, disabled_variant_small-mmap-v2].
